$comment: The pools on the mainnet forknet. Add yours by opening a PR that appends one object to "pools". Every field marked required in README.md must be present, and "chain" must read "mainnet". coinbase_tag is the important one: it is the only thing that lets an explorer attribute a mined block to you. This file is hand-edited; the pools-v2.json beside it is generated from it by tools/build.py, so run that script and commit its output in the same PR.

pools.name: FreeBank
pools.payout: Solo self-mining by the FreeBank sidechain operator (BIP300 slot 130). The coinbase pays the operator address directly; no public hashpower is solicited.

pools.name: eCPool.tech
pools.payout: The stratum username is your address (bc1q or bc1p); the coinbase pays every miner in the PPLNS window directly, so the pool never holds funds. Port 3336 is solo mode, 3335 and 3337 are for rented hashrate.

pools.name: Pow.re
pools.payout: Pow.re's own fleet only, no outside hashrate. Solo mode: each block's coinbase pays Pow.re's address directly.
